title: The Colony of Halcyon Drift
author: Noor Zhou
blurb: Oscar Eriksen, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
